title: Event | Register: Google Singapore — AI for Overseas Chinese Founders (Nov 22)
summary: AI is remaking business, culture, and opportunity — especially for overseas Chinese founders at the frontier. Unique Research / partners invite you to a Google ecosystem briefing on powering global and AI businesses.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Event · November 8, 2024

AI is remaking business, culture, and opportunity — especially for overseas Chinese founders at the frontier. Unique Research / partners invite you to a Google ecosystem briefing on powering global and AI businesses.

Profile

  • Name: AI-Driven, Tech-Enabled — Google Helps Overseas Chinese Seize Global Opportunity
  • When: November 22, 2024 · 14:00–17:00
  • Where: Google Office, Singapore
  • Language: Mandarin
  • Admission: Application + review; approved guests get invite email

Highlights

  • Master Concept: GM Jason on Google × Master Concept — pairing Chinese enterprise value with global opportunity; Gemini + Google ecosystem for globalization.
  • Google Cloud AI: senior architects on leading cloud AI tech/scenes; efficiency and cost for global competitiveness.
  • Google Maps Platform: logistics, travel, F&B case studies — UX and ops efficiency.
  • Fireside: Q&A with industry leaders; Cloud & Maps success stories.

Limited seats — scan poster QR in CN package to apply. Agenda details on poster/images (attach on ingest).

— END —
